title: Best AI Face Swap Tools in 2026: 8 Compared
summary: The best AI face swap tools of 2026: 8 photo and video face swappers compared by free use and price, from each maker's own pages, plus the consent rules.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI face swap tool?


Start from what you are swapping and whose face it is, then check how the tool counts free use and how you would pay, in that order.


1.


### 1


Name the job


A single photo, a group shot, a video clip, a GIF and a character who appears across a whole story each point to a different kind of tool.


2.


### 2


Check the faces


Use your own face, a face you have permission to use or an invented one, because the makers ask for that and some ban deceptive swaps outright.


3.


### 3


Count the free use


Free swaps a day, credits at sign-up and watermarked results run out differently, so try the swaps you actually need before you pay.


4.


### 4


Choose how to pay


A monthly plan, a yearly plan, one-time credits and an in-app subscription cost very different amounts over a year of use.
